341|61263643.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, HGUUL.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

97234-accept.name: Roy Lewells
97234-accept.text:
Are you here to discuss the deeper meanings of our storied legends? No?

Well, after you're done looking around, can you carry this to the library for me? We're exchanging some of our less popular bodies of work for some more modern writing. I have a list of tomes I'm quite sure the librarian will be able to procure for us within our existing arrangement.

Complimentary club refreshments on us, if you help us out.
97234-accept.title: Reading Room

97234-complete.name: Donyal Tovald
97234-complete.text:
Let's see here. Roy's Book Club, isn't it? I recognize this wrap technique. 

Well, if he says this is what people want to talk about, it's all fine by me. The material we receive back is always in as good of quality as we loaned it, so we know they're treating it with respect regardless of how provoking the words may be.
97234-complete.title: Reading Room

97237-accept.name: Donyal Tovald
97237-accept.text:
I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.

You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

Good day, $N.
97237-accept.title: Shelf Picked

97237-complete.name: Roy Lewells
97237-complete.text:
These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.

Cellar after hours, of course.

Thanks for the quick errand run, $N. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
97237-complete.title: Shelf Picked

97237-progress.name: Roy Lewells
97237-progress.text: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.
97237-progress.title: Shelf Picked

98093-accept.name: Sulhasa
98093-accept.text:
I'm so glad you saw me!

The weather was lovely this morning, so I walked from Camp Taurajo down the golden road. When it came time to head back, I couldn't--a pack of hyenas started circling, and Stormhide lizards blocked my only escape.

Scrambling up this tree I went, and now there are too many foes about at this hour for me to make the run home through the fields.

Would you mind clearing out these Stormhide and Hecklefang Stalkers for me?
98093-accept.title: Field to Clear

98093-complete.name: Sulhasa
98093-complete.text:
Thank you for helping me out, $N. I'll let Camp Taurajo know you were able to rescue me. I'm so lucky you helped, I could have been stuck there all day!

This is all I have to spare, but I hope it's useful to you.

I'll be making my exit once I make the careful climb down.
98093-complete.title: Field to Clear
